title: Water Fill Error
shortDescription: The washer is not filling with water.
fullDescription: Error F1 indicates insufficient water supply to the washer. Check taps, hoses, and filters.

causes.cause: Component for water fill error has failed

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Check the relevant component for visible issues.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Use multimeter to verify electrical values.

whenToCallPro: If basic troubleshooting does not resolve the error, contact Asko service.

faq.q: What does Asko error F1 mean?
faq.a: The washer is not filling with water.

faq.q: How do I reset my Asko washer?
faq.a: Turn off and unplug the washer for 5 minutes, then plug back in and restart.
DIY repairs typically cost 0-100 dollars. Professional service runs 100-300 dollars.
